commonNameZh: 志留纪齿旋软骨鱼干群
overview: A late Aeronian stem chondrichthyan known from twenty-three isolated tooth whorls rather than an articulated body or jaw.

ecology.diet: Undetermined; tooth whorls do not preserve feeding events
ecology.habitat: Rongxi Formation depositional setting; life habitat unresolved

evidenceSummary: IVPP V26641 and referred whorls directly record dentition and histology at about 439 Ma, but associated body anatomy, crown membership and global range remain unknown.

overview: A near-complete Telychian total-group chondrichthyan combining a scale-covered body and chondrichthyan-like branchial region with macromeric thoracic armour.

ecology.habitat: Huixingshao Formation depositional setting; life habitat unresolved
ecology.locomotion: Aquatic body form preserved; performance not measured

evidenceSummary: The sole holotype IVPP V300000 supplies exceptional body-plan evidence while leaving exact stem placement, ecology and population variation unresolved.

commonNameZh: 泥盆纪镶嵌型软骨鱼干群
overview: A Givetian stem chondrichthyan known from one compressed specimen whose CT and histology reveal an anatomically incongruent character mosaic.

ecology.habitat: Lower Plattenkalk depositional setting; life habitat unresolved

traits: Scales and teeth preserved in one slab
evidenceSummary: UMZC 2000.32 documents multiple anatomical systems and chondrichthyan-stem placement, but compression, one individual and matrix sensitivity limit broader inference.
